create_pipeline_subclass: create a subclass of Pipeline that implements __init__ with model_id and __call__ to process inputs
implement_pipeline_call: implement the __call__ method in a Pipeline subclass to handle arbitrary input data
raise_pipeline_exception: raise a PipelineException when a spaCy pipeline encounters an unrecoverable error
review_pipeline_abc: review the Pipeline abstract base class to understand the required interface for spaCy pipeline implementations
refactor_pipeline_init: refactor a Pipeline subclass __init__ to accept and store a model_id string parameter
